modules.name: Vinylizer Fable
modules.description: The sound of a 90s record from the physics of the chain, no crackle: elliptic EQ, cutter HF limiter, record curve and cut level, lacquer / DMM / dub plate, stylus tracing and inner groove distortion, tracking and mistracking, MM cartridge loading, arm resonance and warps, platter wow, and the phono preamp
